entries.title: Action definition missing at prepare-starlens path
entries.root_cause: The workflow uses .github/actions/prepare-starlens, where the runner cannot find an action definition or Dockerfile after checkout.

entries.title: Compilation cannot find getBearing
entries.root_cause: MeridianProjector calls getBearing() on an ObservationRecord, but the compiler cannot find that method.

entries.title: Compilation cannot find getDeclination
entries.root_cause: MeridianProjector calls getDeclination() on a CalibrationProfile, but the compiler cannot find that method.
entries.differs_from_earlier: Like e2, javac reports a missing method in MeridianProjector, but this is a different receiver and accessor requiring a separate source change.
